errors.evidence: The description states that the sector for "Твърди горива" (Solid fuels) is red, but in the pie chart, it is represented by a dark blue color.

The description states that the sector for "Електрическа енергия" (Electrical energy) is dark blue, but it is represented by a teal/light blue color in the chart. The dark blue slice actually corresponds to "Твърди горива" (Solid fuels).
The description incorrectly transcribes the label as "Възобнов. и биогаз" (biogas), whereas the legend in the figure clearly states "Възобн. и биогорива" (biofuels).
The description states that the sector for "Топлина енергия" (Heat energy) is yellow, but it is orange in the chart.
The description states that the sector for "Течни горива" (Liquid fuels) is blue, but it is red in the chart.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от сектора „Течни горива“ и завършвайки с „Твърди горива“.
errors.evidence: The statement that the sectors are arranged in descending order is incorrect. The percentages of the sectors, when read clockwise from the top, are 4.1%, 36.3%, 13.3%, 14.4%, 26.4%, and 5.5%, which does not follow a descending or any other clear order.
